decision: The finer own kernel events justified experiment 50: cache a contiguous transposed down weight while preserving row-major activations. No custom fused normalization, residual or MLP epilogue kernels, sparse updates or incremental cache mutation are available.

public_kernel_profile_review.scope: Own selected experiment 41; original one public case, first and next forward. No new score or GPU evaluation for the trace.
public_kernel_profile_review.attribution_method: Original kernel External id links to CPU op; CPU operation containment in layer-node annotation; matching runtime correlation checked. Nine non-layer kernels per forward are not attributed to editable nodes.
public_kernel_profile_review.actionable_argument: The down projection has equal multiply count to gate/up but a greater duration. Test a physically contiguous transposed down weight, changing storage/dispatch without reversing activation/output orientation or splitting reductions.
public_kernel_profile_review.decision: Valid and numerically exact but no Dev speed advantage; allocation rises by 3817628160 bytes. Reject further unsupported physical-layout sweeps.
public_kernel_profile_review.caution: Kernel duration sums, CPU inclusive times and GPU annotations can overlap and instrumentation perturbs timing. These are not new scores or research clocks.

remaining_directions_review: MLP GEMMs dominate recurring GPU work; contraction orientation, token-row partition and physical down-weight layout have now all failed to improve selected Dev reward.
SiLU and gate multiply kernels take about 1.793 ms in this diagnostic but no fused epilogue/kernel operator exists. Remaining fixed RMS/softmax operators cannot be custom-fused.
Kernel events give no bandwidth/cache counters or supported alternative dispatch argument for sweeping faster gate/up weight layouts or reduction tiles.
Attention layouts, grouped products, score orientations and query partitioning were already tested. The finer events supply no new preserving factorization.
Prefix construction remains included and invariant work is already cached. Image states change; no additional valid first-value reuse follows from kernel events.
Formal 256-stage cache amortization is untested and is not inferred from the 32-stage aggregate feedback.
